items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Then I played with, uh, Pajot. Willie Pajot.

ctx.x: Mostly private parties. Yeah, yeah, parties, see.

He used to get those lawn parties at the time. Okay. And, uh, played with Rene a couple of times, that long part. Kid Rene? Yeah, Kid Rene. And, uh, his brother was playing drums. Then I played with, uh, Pajot. Willie Pajot.
